events.title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
events.description: The Apollo 11 lunar module Eagle landed on the Moon in the Sea of Tranquility. Astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin became the first humans to walk on the lunar surface, with Armstrong stepping out hours after the landing (early July 21 UTC), while Michael Collins remained in orbit.
events.significance: Marked the fulfillment of President Kennedy's goal of landing a man on the Moon and returning him safely, and stands as a defining achievement in human space exploration and the Cold War space race.

events.title: July 20 Plot to Assassinate Hitler
events.description: Colonel Claus von Stauffenberg planted a bomb in a briefcase at Hitler's Wolf's Lair headquarters in East Prussia. Hitler survived with minor injuries, and the coup attempt, known as Operation Valkyrie, collapsed in Berlin within hours. Stauffenberg and other conspirators were executed that night.
events.significance: It was the most significant internal German resistance attempt against the Nazi regime, and its failure led to brutal reprisals and the execution or imprisonment of thousands.

events.title: Viking 1 Lands on Mars
events.description: NASA's Viking 1 lander touched down on Mars at Chryse Planitia, becoming the first American spacecraft to successfully land on the Martian surface and transmit images back to Earth.
events.significance: Provided the first detailed surface images of Mars and conducted experiments searching for signs of life, greatly advancing planetary science.

events.significance: The addition of British Columbia extended Canada to the Pacific coast and fulfilled a key part of the vision of a transcontinental nation.

events.title: Death of Pancho Villa
events.description: Mexican Revolution leader Francisco 'Pancho' Villa was assassinated in an ambush while traveling in his car in Parral, Chihuahua, Mexico.
events.significance: Villa's death removed one of the most prominent and controversial figures of the Mexican Revolution, who remains a folk hero in Mexican history.
